# AI-07: Agentic Workflows and Orchestration (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** AI Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Workflow versus agent patterns, multi-step pipelines, Model Context Protocol, multi-agent coordination and durable execution.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has one assessment, a deterministic multi-step workflow with explicit state. Open-ended orchestration needs agent and evaluation fluency, so most of this unit sits at Tiers 2 and 3.
